gitCommit.subject: Public site: a custom "Page not found" — a real 404 in EN/FR/AR, the app's frame under /in-app/
gitCommit.body:
Public site: a custom "Page not found" — a real 404 in EN/FR/AR, the app's frame under /in-app/

- pages/public/NotFound.tsx: the navy band with a typographic 404 (two fours
  around a ring with one amber point, inline SVG, aria-hidden), one heading,
  a short explanation, "Back to home" and "Contact us", and a row of the pages
  most asked for. Light and dark, RTL, reduced motion, 44 px targets; nothing
  from the address is shown back.
- Under /in-app/ (every language) an unknown address keeps the app's frame:
  the help and legal pages only, its one action the in-app support page.
- prerender: one 404.html per language directory (/, /fr/, /ar/) and per
  language for /in-app/, each with its lang, dir, title and noindex. Cloudflare
  Pages serves the nearest 404.html with a 404 status; no rewrite, no redirect.
- The router renders the same page after a link inside the site, and the head
  drops the previous page's canonical, alternates and description (noindex).
- serve-dist: the nearest-404.html rule, as the host applies it.
- Tests: test/not-found.test.tsx (15), 24 browser checks in the public suite
  (status, language, assets at depth, axe, 320 px, client navigation, language
  switch, stored language, theme); the Arabic label in public-pages.test.
